title.zh: 卷九十八 志第四十六: 兵一
title.raw: 卷九十八 志第四十六: 兵一 Volume 98 Treatises 51: Military 1

sentences.zh: 兵者，先王所以威天下，而折奪奸宄、戡定禍亂者也。

translations.literal: As for military affairs, they are what former kings used to awe the realm, to break and seize traitors and villains, and to quell and settle calamities and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Military power is what the ancient kings employed to overawe the realm, to crush treason and villainy, and to put down calamity and rebellion.

sentences.zh: 三代之制遠矣，漢、唐而下，其法變更不一。

translations.literal: The institutions of the Three Dynasties are remote; from Han and Tang downward, their regulations have changed without uniformity.
translations.idiomatic: The institutions of the Three Dynasties lie far in the past; from Han and Tang onward, military law has shifted again and again without a single fixed pattern.

sentences.zh: 大抵用得其道，則兵力富，而國勢強；

translations.literal: Generally speaking, if employed according to the right way, then military strength is abundant and national power is strong;
translations.idiomatic: Broadly speaking, when military institutions are applied as they should be, forces grow plentiful and the state grows strong;

sentences.zh: 用失其宜，則兵力耗，而國勢弱。

translations.literal: if employed contrary to what is fitting, then military strength is depleted and national power is weak.
translations.idiomatic: when they are misapplied, forces are drained away and the state is weakened.

sentences.zh: 故兵制之得失，國勢之盛衰系焉。

translations.literal: Therefore whether military institutions succeed or fail is bound up with whether national power flourishes or declines.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the success or failure of military institutions is tied directly to the rise and fall of national power.

sentences.zh: 考之國初，典兵之官，視兵數多寡，為爵秩崇卑，長萬夫者為萬戶，千夫者為千戶，百夫者為百戶。

translations.literal: Examining the beginning of the state, the officials in charge of troops, according to whether the number of soldiers was many or few, were given ranks noble or base: one who commanded ten thousand men was a myriarch, one who commanded a thousand was a chiliarch, and one who commanded a hundred was a centurion.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty, commanders were ranked according to how many men they led: the commander of ten thousand was a myriarch, of a thousand a chiliarch, of a hundred a centurion.

sentences.zh: 世祖時，頗修官制，內立五衛，以總宿衛諸軍，衛設親軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: In the time of Shizu, the official system was considerably revised; within the capital five guards were established to oversee all palace-guard troops, and each guard was given a commander-in-chief of the personal army;
translations.idiomatic: Under Kublai Khan the official system was substantially reorganized: five guards were set up within the capital to command all palace-guard forces, each guard headed by a commander-in-chief of the personal army;

sentences.zh: 外則萬戶之下置總管，千戶之下置總把，百戶之下置彈壓，立樞密院以總之。

translations.literal: outside, under the myriarchs were placed chief administrators, under the chiliarchs chief captains, under the centurions suppressors, and the Bureau of Military Affairs was established to oversee them all.
translations.idiomatic: in the field, chief administrators were placed under myriarchs, chief captains under chiliarchs, and suppressors under centurions, while a Bureau of Military Affairs was created to supervise the whole system.

sentences.zh: 遇方面有警，則置行樞密院，事已則廢，而移都鎮撫司屬行省。

translations.literal: When there was alarm on a frontier, a traveling Bureau of Military Affairs was established; when the affair was finished it was abolished, and the metropolitan pacification commission was transferred to belong to the branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When trouble arose on a frontier, a traveling bureau of military affairs was set up; once the crisis passed it was dissolved, and metropolitan pacification offices were placed under the provincial secretariats.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶、百戶分上中下。

translations.literal: Myriarchs, chiliarchs, and centurions were divided into upper, middle, and lower grades.
translations.idiomatic: Myriarchs, chiliarchs, and centurions were each ranked upper, middle, or lower.

sentences.zh: 萬戶佩金虎符，符趺為伏虎形，首為明珠，而有三珠、二珠、一珠之別。

translations.literal: Myriarchs wore golden tiger tallies; the base of the tally was in the shape of a crouching tiger, the head was a bright pearl, and there were distinctions of three pearls, two pearls, and one pearl.
translations.idiomatic: Myriarchs carried golden tiger tallies whose base was a crouching tiger and whose head was a bright pearl, distinguished as bearing three pearls, two pearls, or one pearl.

sentences.zh: 千戶金符，百戶銀符。

translations.literal: Chiliarchs had golden tallies, centurions silver tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Chiliarchs held gold tallies and centurions silver tallies.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶死陣者，子孫襲爵，死病則降一等。

translations.literal: If myriarchs or chiliarchs died in battle, their descendants inherited the rank; if they died of illness, the rank was lowered one grade.
translations.idiomatic: When a myriarch or chiliarch fell in battle, his descendants inherited his rank; death from illness reduced the rank by one grade.

sentences.zh: 總把、百戶老死，萬戶遷他官，皆不得襲。

translations.literal: When chief captains or centurions died of old age, or myriarchs were transferred to other offices, none of these ranks could be inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Chief captains and centurions who died of old age, and myriarchs transferred to other posts, could not pass their offices to heirs.

sentences.zh: 是法尋廢，後無大小，皆世其官，獨以罪去者則否。

translations.literal: This law was soon abandoned; afterward, without distinction of rank high or low, all offices were hereditary, except for those removed because of crime.
translations.idiomatic: That law was soon dropped; thereafter every post, high or low, became hereditary, except when an officer was removed for a crime.

sentences.zh: 若夫軍士，則初有蒙古軍、探馬赤軍。

translations.literal: As for the soldiers, at first there were the Mongol Army and the Tamma Army.
translations.idiomatic: As for the soldiery, there were at first the Mongol Army and the Tamma cavalry.

sentences.zh: 蒙古軍皆國人，探馬赤軍則諸部族也。

translations.literal: The Mongol Army were all men of the state; the Tamma Army were the various tribal peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Army consisted entirely of native Mongols; the Tamma were drawn from the various tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 其法，家有男子，十五以上、七十以下，無眾寡盡簽為兵。

translations.literal: By their regulation, in every household with males from fifteen upward to seventy downward, without regard to whether few or many, all were registered as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Under their rule, every household with males between fifteen and seventy was conscripted in full, whether the household was large or small.

sentences.zh: 十人為一牌，設牌頭，上馬則備戰鬥，下馬則屯聚牧養。

translations.literal: Ten men formed one arban, with an arban head appointed; when mounted they prepared for battle, when dismounted they gathered to pasture and raise livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Ten men formed an arban under an arban head: mounted, they stood ready for battle; dismounted, they camped together to pasture and raise stock.

sentences.zh: 孩幼稍長，又籍之，曰漸丁軍。

translations.literal: When children grew somewhat older, they were again registered; these were called the Gradual Muster Army.
translations.idiomatic: Boys who had grown a little older were registered again as the Gradual Muster Army.

sentences.zh: 既平中原，發民為卒，是為漢軍。

translations.literal: After the Central Plains were pacified, the people were levied as soldiers; these were the Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Central Plains had been pacified, civilians were drafted as troops—the Han Army.

sentences.zh: 或以貧富為甲乙，戶出一人，曰獨戶軍，合二三而出一人，則為正軍戶，余為貼軍戶。

translations.literal: Sometimes, according to wealth graded as first or second class, one man was taken from a household; these were called sole-household troops. When two or three households together furnished one man, they became the principal military household, the rest being supplementary military households.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes households were graded by wealth: one man from a single household made a sole-household soldier; when two or three households together supplied one man, one became the principal military household and the others supplementary households.

sentences.zh: 或以男丁論，嘗以二十丁出一卒，至元七年十丁出一卒。

translations.literal: Sometimes it was reckoned by adult males: once one soldier was taken from twenty males; in the seventh year of Zhiyuan, one soldier from ten males.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes the levy was counted by adult males: formerly one soldier per twenty males; in Zhiyuan 7 (1270), one per ten.

sentences.zh: 或以戶論，二十戶出一卒，而限年二十以上者充。

translations.literal: Sometimes it was reckoned by households: one soldier from twenty households, limited to those twenty years of age and above to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes by households: one soldier from twenty households, limited to men aged twenty or above.

sentences.zh: 士卒之家，為富商大賈，則又取一人，曰余丁軍，至十五年免。

translations.literal: In soldier households that were great merchants, another man was taken; these were called surplus-male troops, exempted after fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Soldier households that were wealthy merchants supplied an additional man as surplus-male troops, exempt after fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 或取匠為軍，曰匠軍。

translations.literal: Sometimes artisans were taken as soldiers; these were called the Artisan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes artisans were drafted as the Artisan Army.

sentences.zh: 或取諸侯將校之子弟充軍，曰質子軍，又曰禿魯華軍。

translations.literal: Sometimes the sons and younger brothers of feudal lords and officers were made to serve as soldiers; these were called the Hostage Army, also called the Tulughachi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes the sons of princes and commanders were enrolled as the Hostage Army, also known as the Tulughachi Army.

sentences.zh: 是皆多事之際，一時之制。

translations.literal: These were all measures of a time of many affairs, institutions for the moment.
translations.idiomatic: All of these were expedients of troubled times, not permanent institutions.

sentences.zh: 天下既平，嘗為軍者，定入尺籍伍符，不可更易。

translations.literal: After the realm was pacified, those who had once been soldiers were fixed in the household register and company tally, and could not be changed.
translations.idiomatic: Once the realm was at peace, former soldiers were entered permanently in the household register and company tally and could not be reassigned.

sentences.zh: 詐增損丁產者，覺則更籍其實，而以印印之。

translations.literal: Those who fraudulently increased or decreased adult males or property, once discovered, had the register revised to the true figures and were stamped with a seal.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who falsified household size or property was, when found out, re-registered to the true figures and marked with an official seal.

sentences.zh: 病死戍所者，百日外役次丁；

translations.literal: if one died of illness at a garrison post, after a hundred days the next adult male was levied for service;
translations.idiomatic: If a soldier died of illness at a garrison, after a hundred days the next adult male in the household was called up;

sentences.zh: 死陣者，復一年。

translations.literal: if one died in battle, there was a reprieve of one year.
translations.idiomatic: if he fell in battle, the household was granted a one-year reprieve.

sentences.zh: 貧不能役，則聚而一之，曰合並；

translations.literal: if too poor to perform service, households were gathered and made one; this was called consolidation;
translations.idiomatic: Households too poor to serve alone were combined into one levy, called consolidation;

sentences.zh: 貧甚者、老無子者，落其籍。

translations.literal: those extremely poor, or old and without sons, were struck from the register.
translations.idiomatic: the desperately poor and the childless elderly were removed from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 戶絕者，別以民補之。

translations.literal: When a household line was extinguished, civilians were separately used to fill the gap.
translations.idiomatic: When a military household died out, civilians were drafted to replace it.

sentences.zh: 奴得縱自便者，俾為其主貼軍。

translations.literal: Slaves who were allowed to go their own way were made to serve as supplementary soldiers for their masters.
translations.idiomatic: Freed slaves were required to serve as supplementary soldiers for their former masters.

sentences.zh: 其戶逃而還者，復三年，又逃者杖之，投他役者還籍。

translations.literal: If the household fled and returned, there was a reprieve of three years; if they fled again they were beaten with the staff; those who entered other service were returned to the register.
translations.idiomatic: A household that fled and returned was granted three years' reprieve; a second flight brought beating; those who took other employment were restored to the military rolls.

sentences.zh: 其繼得宋兵，號新附軍。

translations.literal: Those who successively received Song troops were called the Newly Attached Army.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops taken over in succession were called the Newly Attached Army.

sentences.zh: 又有遼東之糺軍、契丹軍、女直軍、高麗軍，雲南之寸白軍，福建之畬軍，則皆不出戍他方者，蓋鄉兵也。

translations.literal: There were also in Liaodong the Jiu Army, Khitan Army, Jurchen Army, and Korean Army; in Yunnan the Cunbai Army; in Fujian the She Army—all of which did not go out to garrison other regions; these were essentially local militia.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong had the Jiu, Khitan, Jurchen, and Korean armies; Yunnan the Cunbai; Fujian the She—all local forces that did not garrison abroad.

sentences.zh: 又有以技名者，曰炮軍、弩軍、水手軍。

translations.literal: There were also those named for their skill: the Artillery Army, Crossbow Army, and Sailor Army.
translations.idiomatic: Others were named for their specialty: artillery, crossbow, and sailor corps.

sentences.zh: 應募而集者，曰答剌罕軍。

translations.literal: Those who answered the call and were gathered were called the Talqan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteers who answered the call were the Talqan Army.

sentences.zh: 其名數，則有憲宗二年之籍、世祖至元八年之籍、十一年之籍，而新附軍有二十七年之籍。

translations.literal: As for their names and numbers, there were registers of the second year of Xianzong, registers of the eighth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, registers of the eleventh year, and for the Newly Attached Army registers of the twenty-seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: Their rolls included Möngke's second year, Kublai's eighth and eleventh years of Zhiyuan, and for the Newly Attached Army the twenty-seventh year.

sentences.zh: 以兵籍系軍機重務，漢人不閱其數。

translations.literal: Because the military registers concerned weighty military secrets, Han Chinese did not inspect their numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Because the military rolls touched vital state secrets, Han officials were not allowed to review the figures.

sentences.zh: 雖樞密近臣職專軍旅者，惟長官一二人知之。

translations.literal: Even among close ministers of the Bureau of Military Affairs whose duty was devoted to the army, only one or two chief officers knew them.
translations.idiomatic: Even among the bureau's inner circle, whose sole charge was the army, only one or two senior officers knew the totals.

sentences.zh: 故有國百年，而內外兵數之多寡，人莫有知之者。

translations.literal: Therefore, though the state had endured a hundred years, no one knew how many or few were the troops within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Thus for a century of rule no one knew how large or small the forces at home and abroad truly were.

sentences.zh: 今其典籍可考者，曰兵制，曰宿衛，曰鎮戍，而馬政、屯田、站赤、弓手、急遞鋪兵、鷹房捕獵，非兵而兵者，亦以類附焉，作《兵志》。

translations.literal: Now what can be examined in the records are: military institutions, palace guard, and frontier garrison; while horse administration, military colonies, relay stations, archers, express-courier post soldiers, and falconry hunting—though not armies yet army-like—are also appended by category; thus the 'Treatise on Military Affairs' is composed.
translations.idiomatic: What survives in the records falls under military institutions, palace guard, and frontier garrison; horse administration, colonies, relay stations, archers, courier posts, and falconry—matters not strictly military yet akin to it—are grouped here as well in this Treatise on Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: ○兵制

translations.literal: ○ Military Institutions
translations.idiomatic: ○ Military Institutions

sentences.zh: 七年七月，簽宣德、西京、平陽、太原、陜西五路人匠充軍，命各處管匠頭目，除織匠及和林建宮殿一切合幹人等外，應有回回、河西、漢兒匠人，並劄魯花赤及劄也、種田人等，通驗丁數，每二十人出軍一名。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year, artisans of the five circuits of Xuande, Xijing, Pingyang, Taiyuan, and Shaanxi were registered as soldiers. It was ordered that everywhere the heads in charge of artisans, excepting weavers and all persons fit for service in building palaces at Karakorum, should include all Muslim, Hexi, and Han artisans, together with darughachi, zhaliye, and farming people, and after verifying the number of adult males, one soldier was to be taken from every twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 7, artisans from the Xuande, Xijing, Pingyang, Taiyuan, and Shaanxi circuits were conscripted. Local craft supervisors were to register all Muslim, Hexi, and Han artisans, together with darughachi, zhaliye, and farmers—excluding weavers and those assigned to palace construction at Karakorum—and levy one soldier per twenty adult males.

sentences.zh: 八年七月，詔：「燕京路保州等處，每二十戶簽軍一名，令答不葉兒統領出軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighth year, an edict stated: 'In Baozhou and other places of the Yanjing circuit, one soldier is to be registered from every twenty households, and Tabunai'er is to command them in taking the field.'
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 8 an edict ordered: 'In Baozhou and elsewhere in the Yanjing circuit, conscript one soldier per twenty households and place them under Tabunai'er's command for campaign.'

sentences.zh: 真定、河間、邢州、大名、太原等路，除先簽軍人外，於斷事官忽都虎新籍民戶三十七萬二千九百七十二人數內，每二十丁起軍一名，亦令屬答不葉兒領之。」

translations.literal: In the circuits of Zhending, Hejian, Xingzhou, Daming, Taiyuan, and others, apart from those previously registered as soldiers, from among the 372,972 persons in the newly registered civilian households of the judicial officer Huduhu, one soldier was to be raised from every twenty adult males, and they too were to be placed under Tabunai'er's command.'
translations.idiomatic: 'In Zhending, Hejian, Xingzhou, Daming, Taiyuan, and other circuits, apart from men already conscripted, levy one soldier per twenty adult males from the 372,972 persons newly registered by the judicial officer Huduhu, and assign them likewise to Tabunai'er.'

sentences.zh: 十三年八月，諭總管萬戶劉黑馬，據斜烈奏，忽都虎等元籍諸路民戶一百萬四千六百五十六戶，除逃戶外，有七十二萬三千九百一十戶，隨路總簽軍一十萬五千四百七十一名，點數過九萬七千五百七十五人，余因近年蝗旱，民力艱難，往往在逃。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year, the chief administrator myriarch Liu Heima was instructed: according to the memorial of Xielie, Huduhu and others had originally registered civilian households of the various circuits at 1,004,656 households; apart from fugitive households there were 723,910 households, and soldiers registered circuit by circuit totaled 105,471; after muster there were 97,575 persons, the remainder because in recent years there had been locusts and drought, the people's strength was hard pressed, and many were constantly in flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 13 Liu Heima, chief myriarch, was instructed: per Xielie's memorial, Huduhu had originally registered 1,004,656 households across the circuits; excluding fugitives, 723,910 remained and 105,471 soldiers were conscripted circuit by circuit. Muster found only 97,575 present—the rest having fled amid recent locust plague and drought.

sentences.zh: 有旨，今後止驗見在民戶簽軍，仍命逃戶復業者免三年軍役。

translations.literal: There was an imperial order that henceforth soldiers should be registered only from households actually present, and fugitive households returning to their occupations were ordered exempt from military service for three years.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered that henceforth conscription should count only households actually present, and fugitives who returned to farming were exempt from military service for three years.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，詔：「真定、彰德、邢州、洺磁、東平、大名、平陽、太原、衛輝、懷孟等路各處，有舊屬按劄兒、孛羅、笑乃<角┦>、闊闊不花、不裏合拔都兒等官所管探馬赤軍人，乙卯歲籍為民戶，亦有簽充軍者。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, an edict stated: 'In various places of the circuits of Zhending, Zhangde, Xingzhou, Luoci, Dongping, Daming, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Weihui, Huaimeng, and others, there were Tamma soldiers formerly under officials such as Anzhai'er, Boluo, Xiaonaijiao, Kuokuobuhua, and Bulihebadu'er; in the yimao year they were registered as civilian households, and some were also registered as soldiers.'
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 3 an edict declared: 'In Zhending, Zhangde, Xingzhou, Luoci, Dongping, Daming, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Weihui, Huaimeng, and other circuits, Tamma troops once under officers such as Anzhai'er, Boluo, Xiaonaijiao, Kuokuobuhua, and Bulihebadu'er were in the yimao year registered as civilians, though some had also been conscripted.'

sentences.zh: 若壬寅、甲寅兩次簽定軍，已入籍冊者，令隨各萬戶依舊出征；

translations.literal: As for soldiers fixed in the two registrations of the renyin and jiayin years who were already entered in the registers, they were ordered to follow their respective myriarchs and take the field as before;
translations.idiomatic: Men fixed in the renyin and jiayin registrations and already on the rolls were to march with their myriarchs as before;

sentences.zh: 其或未嘗為軍，及蒙古、漢人民戶內作數者，悉簽為軍。

translations.literal: those who had never been soldiers, and those counted within Mongol and Han civilian households, were all to be registered as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: those never before soldiers, and any counted within Mongol or Han civilian households, were all to be conscripted.'

sentences.zh: 」六月，以軍士訴貧乏者眾，命貧富相兼應役，實有不能自存者優恤三年。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, because many soldiers complained of poverty, it was ordered that rich and poor should jointly perform service; those truly unable to support themselves were given favorable relief for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, because many soldiers pleaded poverty, rich and poor households were ordered to share the burden; those truly unable to subsist received three years' relief.

sentences.zh: 十月，諭山東東路經略司：「益都路匠軍已前曾經簽把者，可遵別路之例，俾令從軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Shandong East Route Pacification Commission was instructed: 'Artisan soldiers of the Yidu circuit who had previously been registered should follow the precedent of other circuits and be made to take the field.'
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Shandong East Route Pacification Commission was told: 'Artisan soldiers of Yidu previously registered should follow other circuits' precedent and be sent to campaign.'

sentences.zh: 」以鳳翔府屯田軍人準充平陽軍數，仍於鳳翔屯田，勿遣從軍。

translations.literal: The garrison-colony soldiers of Fengxiang prefecture were approved to count toward the Pingyang quota of soldiers, but they were still to garrison-colony at Fengxiang and not be sent to take the field.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang's garrison-colony troops were allowed to count toward Pingyang's quota but were to remain farming at Fengxiang and not be sent on campaign.

sentences.zh: 刁國器所管重簽軍九百一十五人，即日放罷為民。

translations.literal: The 915 soldiers doubly registered under Diao Guoqi were on the same day released and made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: The 915 men doubly conscripted under Diao Guoqi were discharged to civilian status that same day.

sentences.zh: 陜西行省言：「士卒戍金州者，諸奧魯已嘗服役，今重勞苦。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat stated: 'The soldiers garrisoning Jinzhou—the various oru have already performed service and are now doubly burdened.'
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported: 'Soldiers garrisoning Jinzhou—their military households have already served and are now doubly overburdened.'

sentences.zh: 」詔罷之。

translations.literal: An edict abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict canceled the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 並罷山東、大名、河南諸路新簽防城戍卒。

translations.literal: At the same time the newly registered wall-guard garrison soldiers of Shandong, Daming, Henan, and other circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Newly conscripted wall-guard garrisons in Shandong, Daming, Henan, and other circuits were abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，詔：「統軍司及管軍萬戶、千戶等，可遵太祖之制，令各官以子弟入朝充禿魯花。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, an edict stated: 'The Army Command and myriarchs, chiliarchs, and others in charge of troops should follow the institution of Taizu and have each officer send his sons and younger brothers to court to serve as tulughachi.'
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 4 an edict ordered: 'The Army Command and field officers from myriarch downward shall follow Genghis Khan's rule and send sons or younger brothers to court as tulughachi hostages.'

sentences.zh: 」其制：萬戶，禿魯花一名，馬一十匹，牛二具，種田人四名。

translations.literal: The regulation was: for a myriarch, one tulughachi, ten horses, two teams of oxen, and four farming laborers.
translations.idiomatic: The rule: each myriarch sent one tulughachi with ten horses, two ox-teams, and four farm laborers.

sentences.zh: 千戶見管軍五百或五百已上者，禿魯花一名，馬六匹，牛一具，種田人二名。

translations.literal: A chiliarch presently commanding five hundred soldiers or five hundred and above: one tulughachi, six horses, one team of oxen, and two farming laborers.
translations.idiomatic: A chiliarch commanding five hundred men or more sent one tulughachi with six horses, one ox-team, and two farm laborers.

sentences.zh: 雖所管軍不及五百，其家富強子弟健壯者，亦出禿魯花一名，馬匹、牛具、種田人同。

translations.literal: Even if the troops commanded were fewer than five hundred, if the household was wealthy and strong and the sons and younger brothers robust, one tulughachi was also to be furnished, with horses, ox-teams, and farming laborers the same.
translations.idiomatic: Even chiliarchs commanding fewer than five hundred men sent a tulughachi if their household was wealthy and their sons fit, with the same horses, ox-teams, and laborers.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶子弟充禿魯花者，挈其妻子同至，從人不拘定數，馬匹、牛具，除定去數目已上，復增余者聽。

translations.literal: Sons and younger brothers of myriarchs and chiliarchs serving as tulughachi were to bring their wives and children with them; attendants were not limited to a fixed number; for horses and ox-teams, beyond the fixed quota sent, additional surplus was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tulughachi sons of myriarchs and chiliarchs were to bring wives and children; attendants were unlimited; horses and ox-teams beyond the fixed quota were permitted.

sentences.zh: 若有貧乏不能自備者，於本萬戶內不該出禿魯花之人，通行津濟起發，不得因而科及眾軍。

translations.literal: If there were poor persons unable to equip themselves, within that myriarch's command those not obliged to furnish tulughachi were to assist them in setting out, and the levy must not be extended to the mass of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Those too poor to equip themselves were to be aided from within the myriarchy by men not liable for tulughachi service, without levying the cost on ordinary troops.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶或無親子、或親子幼弱未及成人者，以弟侄充，候親子年及十五，卻行交換。

translations.literal: If a myriarch or chiliarch had no son of his own, or his son was young and weak and had not yet reached adulthood, a younger brother or nephew might serve instead; when the son reached fifteen years, the exchange was to be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Myriarchs or chiliarchs without sons, or with sons still under fifteen, might send younger brothers or nephews instead, exchanging them when the son turned fifteen.

sentences.zh: 若委有親子，不得隱匿代替，委有氣力，不得妄稱貧乏，及雖到來，氣力卻有不完者，並罪之。

translations.literal: If there truly was a son of one's own, he might not be concealed and another substituted; if there truly was strength, one might not falsely claim poverty; and if though having come, one's strength was nevertheless incomplete—all were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who truly had sons might not hide them and send substitutes; those truly able might not falsely plead poverty; and those who arrived unfit—all were punishable.

sentences.zh: 是月，帝以太宗舊制，設官分職，軍民之事，各有所司。

translations.literal: That month, the emperor, following the old institutions of Taizong, established officials and divided duties so that military and civilian affairs each had its own charge.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor restored Ögedei's practice of separate offices for military and civilian affairs.

sentences.zh: 後多故之際，不暇分別，命阿海充都元帥，專於北京、東京、平灤、懿州、蓋州路管領見管軍人，凡民間之事毋得預焉。

translations.literal: Later, in a time of many affairs, there was no leisure to distinguish them; Ahai was appointed supreme commander, charged solely with the circuits of Beijing, Dongjing, Pingluan, Yizhou, and Gaizhou to oversee the soldiers presently under command, and he was not to intervene in any civilian matters.
translations.idiomatic: Later, amid constant crises, the distinction lapsed; Ahai was made supreme commander over troops in Beijing, Dongjing, Pingluan, Yizhou, and Gaizhou, with no authority over civilian affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月，立樞密院，凡蒙古、漢軍並聽樞密節制。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Bureau of Military Affairs was established; all Mongol and Han armies alike were to obey the bureau's regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Bureau of Military Affairs was founded; all Mongol and Han forces came under its command.

sentences.zh: 統軍司、都元帥府，除遇邊面緊急事務就便調度外，其軍情一切大小公事，並須申覆。

translations.literal: The Army Command and the supreme commander's office, except when frontier emergencies required immediate disposition, had to report and receive approval for all military affairs great and small.
translations.idiomatic: The Army Command and supreme commander's office had to report all military business to the bureau, except for urgent frontier matters requiring immediate action.

sentences.zh: 合設奧魯官，並從樞密院設置。

translations.literal: Oru officials to be established were all to be set up through the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: All oru officials were to be appointed through the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔免河南保甲丁壯、射生軍三千四百四十一戶雜泛科差，專令守把巡哨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, an edict exempted the 3,441 households of Henan baojia strong youths and hunting soldiers from miscellaneous levies, ordering them solely to guard posts and patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month an edict exempted 3,441 Henan baojia and hunting-soldier households from miscellaneous levies, assigning them solely to guard duty and patrol.

sentences.zh: 八月，諭成都路行樞密院：「近年軍人多逃亡事故者，可於各奧魯內盡實簽補，自乙卯年定入軍籍之數，悉簽起赴軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the traveling Bureau of Military Affairs of the Chengdu circuit was instructed: 'In recent years many soldiers have fled or met with accidents; within each oru they should be fully verified and supplemented; from the number fixed in the military register in the yimao year, all are to be registered and sent to the army.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Chengdu traveling bureau was told: 'Because many soldiers have fled in recent years, verify each oru fully and conscript all men fixed in the yimao military rolls.'

sentences.zh: 」十一月，女直、水達達及乞烈賓地合簽鎮守軍，命亦裏不花簽三千人，付塔匣來領之；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jurchens, Suoyet and others, and the land of Qiliebin together were to register garrison soldiers; Yilibuhua was ordered to register three thousand men and hand them to Taxialai to command;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Jurchen, Suoyet, and Qiliebin territories were to supply garrison troops; Yilibuhua was to conscript three thousand men for Taxialai to command;

sentences.zh: 並達魯花赤官之子及其餘近上戶內，亦令簽軍，聽亦裏不花節制。

translations.literal: and from the sons of darughachi officials and from other leading households as well, soldiers were also to be registered, all under Yilibuhua's regulation.
translations.idiomatic: sons of darughachi and other leading households were also to be conscripted under Yilibuhua's command.

sentences.zh: 至元二年八月，陜西五路西蜀四川行省言：「新簽軍七千人，若發民戶，恐致擾亂。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Zhiyuan, the Branch Secretariat of the Five Circuits of Shaanxi, Western Shu, and Sichuan stated: 'The newly registered seven thousand soldiers—if civilian households are levied, we fear disorder will result.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Zhiyuan 2 the Shaanxi and Sichuan Branch Secretariat reported: 'The seven thousand newly conscripted soldiers—levying civilians would risk unrest.'

sentences.zh: 今鞏昌已有舊軍三千，諸路軍二千，余二千人亦不必發民戶，當以便宜起補。

translations.literal: Now Gongchang already has three thousand old soldiers, the various circuits two thousand; for the remaining two thousand there is likewise no need to levy civilian households—they should be supplemented as expedient.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchang already has three thousand veteran troops and other circuits two thousand; the remaining two thousand need not come from civilians but should be filled as circumstances allow.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月，省院官議，收到私走間道、盜販馬匹、曾過南界人三千八百四戶，悉令充軍，以一千九百七十八人與山東路統軍司，一千人與蔡州萬戶，余八百二十六戶，有旨留之軍中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, officials of the secretariat and bureau deliberated: persons received who had privately traveled bypaths, stolen and sold horses, or once crossed the southern frontier—3,804 households—were all ordered to serve as soldiers; 1,978 persons were given to the Shandong Route Army Command, 1,000 to the Caizhou myriarch, and the remaining 826 households were by imperial order kept in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month secretariat and bureau officials decided that 3,804 households caught smuggling horses or crossing the southern frontier were all to be conscripted: 1,978 to the Shandong Army Command, 1,000 to the Caizhou myriarch, and 826 retained in service by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，添內外巡軍，外路每百戶選中產者一人充之，其賦令余戶代輸，在都增武衛軍四百。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, patrol soldiers within and without were added; in outer circuits one man of middle property was chosen from every hundred households to serve, their tax levies paid by the remaining households, and in the capital four hundred Wuwei Guards were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 3 patrol forces were expanded: each hundred households in the provinces supplied one man of middling means, with other households paying his taxes; four hundred Wuwei Guards were added in the capital.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，簽蒙古軍，每戶二丁、三丁者一人，四丁、五丁者二人，六丁、七丁者三人。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Mongol soldiers were registered: from households with two or three adult males, one man; with four or five, two men; with six or seven, three men.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 4 Mongol troops were conscripted: one man from households with two or three adult males, two from four or five, three from six or seven.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔遣官簽平陽、太原人戶為軍，除軍、站、僧、道、也裏可溫、答失蠻、儒人等戶外，於系官、投下民戶、運司戶、人匠、打捕鷹房、金銀鐵冶、丹粉錫碌等，不以是何戶計，驗酌中戶內丁多堪當人戶，簽軍二千人，定立百戶、牌子頭，前赴陜西五路西蜀四川行中書省所轄東川出征。

translations.literal: In the second month, an edict dispatched officials to register households of Pingyang and Taiyuan as soldiers. Apart from military, relay, Buddhist, Daoist, Nestorian, Muslim, and Confucian households, among state-affiliated households, appanage households, transport-office households, artisans, hunting and falconry households, gold, silver, and iron smelting, cinnabar, powder, tin, and related enterprises—without regard to what kind of household—after verifying and selecting middle households with many adult males fit for service, two thousand soldiers were registered, centurions and arban heads were established, and they were sent forward to campaign in eastern Sichuan under the Branch Secretariat of the Five Circuits of Shaanxi, Western Shu, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month officials were sent to conscript Pingyang and Taiyuan households—excluding military, relay, religious, and scholarly households—from state, appanage, transport, artisan, mining, and hunting households alike, selecting middle households with many fit males; two thousand soldiers were raised with centurions and arban heads and sent to eastern Sichuan under the Shaanxi-Sichuan secretariat.

sentences.zh: 復於京兆、延安兩路簽軍一千人，如平陽、太原例。

translations.literal: Again in the Jingzhao and Yan'an circuits one thousand soldiers were registered, following the precedent of Pingyang and Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Another thousand were conscripted in Jingzhao and Yan'an on the same terms.

sentences.zh: 五月，詔：「河南路驗酌中戶內丁多堪當軍人戶，簽軍四百二十名，歸之樞密院，俾從軍，復其徭役。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, an edict stated: 'In the Henan circuit, after verifying and selecting middle households with many adult males fit for military service, register 420 soldiers, assign them to the Bureau of Military Affairs, have them take the field, and restore their corvée labor.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month an edict ordered Henan to conscript 420 soldiers from middle households with many fit males, assign them to the Bureau of Military Affairs for campaign, and restore their corvée obligations.'

sentences.zh: 南京路，除邳州、南宿州外，依中書省分間定應簽軍人戶，驗丁數，簽軍二千五百八十名，管領出征。

translations.literal: In the Nanjing circuit, apart from Pizhou and Nansuzhou, according to the Central Secretariat's division and fixing of households that ought to furnish soldiers, after verifying adult males, 2,580 soldiers were registered and placed in command for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: 'In the Nanjing circuit, except Pizhou and Nansuzhou, follow the Central Secretariat's household quotas, verify adult males, conscript 2,580 soldiers, and send them on campaign.'

sentences.zh: 」十二月，簽女直、水達達軍三千人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, three thousand Jurchen and Suoyet soldiers were registered.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month three thousand Jurchen and Suoyet troops were conscripted.

sentences.zh: 五年閏正月，詔益都李亶元簽軍，仍依舊數充役。

translations.literal: In the intercalary first month of the fifth year, an edict ordered that the soldiers originally registered under Li Chan of Yidu should still perform service according to the former quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary first month of year 5 an edict restored Li Chan's originally conscripted Yidu troops to their former quota of service.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔諸路奧魯毋隸總管府，別設總押所官，聽樞密院節制。

translations.literal: In the second month, an edict ordered that oru of the various circuits should not be subordinate to the chief administrator's office but should have separate chief custodian offices established, subject to the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month an edict removed oru from prefectural control and placed them under separate custodian offices answerable to the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，省臣議：「簽起禿魯花官員，皆已遷轉，或物故黜退者，於內復有貧難蒙古人氏，除隨路總管府達魯花赤、總管及掌兵萬戶，合令應當，其次官員禿魯花，宜放罷，其自願留質者聽之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, secretariat ministers deliberated: 'The tulughachi officers who were registered have all been transferred, or have died or been dismissed; among them there are again poor and distressed Mongol persons. Apart from the darughachi, chief administrators, and myriarchs in charge of troops of each circuit, who ought to perform their duty, the tulughachi of secondary officers should be released; those who voluntarily remain as hostages may do so.'
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month ministers proposed: 'Registered tulughachi have been transferred, died, or dismissed, leaving poor Mongols among them. Only circuit darughachi, prefects, and commanding myriarchs should remain liable; secondary officers' hostages should be released, though volunteers may stay.'

sentences.zh: 」十月，禁長軍之官不得侵漁士卒，違者論罪。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, it was forbidden for officers who commanded troops for long periods to encroach upon and exploit the soldiers; violators were prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month officers in long command were forbidden to exploit their men, on pain of prosecution.

sentences.zh: 十一月，簽山東、河南沿邊州城民戶為軍，遇征進，則選有力之家同元守邊城漢軍一體出征，其無力之家代守邊城及屯田勾當。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, civilian households of frontier prefectures and cities along Shandong and Henan were registered as soldiers; when there was a campaign, powerful households were chosen to take the field together with the original Han soldiers guarding the frontier cities, while powerless households substituted in guarding the frontier cities and performing garrison-colony duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month frontier households in Shandong and Henan were conscripted: on campaign, wealthy households marched with existing Han garrison troops while poorer ones guarded the walls and worked the colonies.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，簽懷孟、衛輝路丁多人戶充軍，益都、淄萊所轄登、萊州李鋋舊軍內，起簽一萬人，差官部領出征。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, households with many adult males in the Huaimeng and Weihui circuits were registered as soldiers; from within Li Chen's old troops in Dengzhou and Laizhou under the jurisdiction of Yidu and Zilai, ten thousand men were raised and registered, and officials were dispatched to lead them on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 6 households with many males in Huaimeng and Weihui were conscripted; ten thousand men were drawn from Li Chen's old Deng and Lai troops under Yidu and Zilai and sent on campaign under dispatched officers.

sentences.zh: 其淄萊路所轄淄、萊等處有非李鋋舊管者，簽五百二十六人，其餘諸色人戶，亦令酌驗丁數，簽軍起遣，至軍前赴役。

translations.literal: In Zibo, Lai, and other places under the Zilai circuit not formerly under Li Chen's command, 526 persons were registered; for the remaining households of various categories as well, they were ordered to verify adult males as appropriate, register soldiers, send them forth, and have them report for service before the army.
translations.idiomatic: Where Zilai places were not under Li Chen, 526 men were conscripted; other households of every category were likewise to supply soldiers verified by adult males and sent to the front.

sentences.zh: 十月，從山東路統軍司言，應系逃軍未獲者，令其次親丁代役，身死軍人亦令親丁代補，無親丁則以少壯驅丁代之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, following the statement of the Shandong Route Army Command, for fugitive soldiers not yet captured, their next adult male kin were to perform service in their stead; when a soldier died, his kin were also to fill the gap; if there were no kin, young and strong bond servants were to substitute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, per the Shandong Army Command, fugitives not yet caught were replaced by the next adult male kin; dead soldiers likewise; if no kin remained, young bond servants served instead.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，定軍官等級，萬戶、千戶、百戶、總把以軍士為差。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, military officer grades were fixed: myriarch, chiliarch, centurion, and chief captain were differentiated by the number of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 7 officer ranks were fixed: myriarch, chiliarch, centurion, and chief captain were graded by the number of troops commanded.

sentences.zh: 六月，成都府括民三萬一千七十五戶，簽義士軍八千六十七人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Chengdu prefecture registered 31,075 civilian households and enrolled 8,067 volunteer soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Chengdu registered 31,075 households and conscripted 8,067 volunteer troops.

sentences.zh: 七月，分揀隨路炮手軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the artillery soldiers of each circuit were sorted and selected.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month artillery troops were sorted circuit by circuit.

sentences.zh: 始太祖、太宗征討之際，於隨路取發，並攻破州縣，招收鐵木金火等人匠充炮手，管領出征，壬子年俱作炮手附籍。

translations.literal: At the beginning, when Taizu and Taizong were on campaign, men were taken and sent out from each circuit; as prefectures and counties were captured, ironworkers, woodworkers, metalworkers, and fireworkers were received as artillerymen, placed in command, and sent on campaign; in the renzi year all were entered in the registers as artillerymen.
translations.idiomatic: When Genghis Khan and Ögedei campaigned, artisans were levied from each circuit; as cities fell, smiths and metalworkers were enrolled as gunners and sent to war; in the renzi year (1252) they were all registered as artillery households.

sentences.zh: 中統四年揀定，除正軍當役外，其餘戶與民一體當差。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhongtong they were selected and fixed; apart from principal soldiers performing service, the remaining households performed corvée together with civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 4 (1263) the rolls were fixed: except for principal soldiers on active duty, other households bore corvée like ordinary civilians.

sentences.zh: 後為出軍正戶煩難，至元四年取元充炮手民戶津貼，其間有能與不能者，影占不便，至是分揀之。

translations.literal: Later, because principal households going on campaign found it burdensome, in the fourth year of Zhiyuan subsidies were taken from the civilian households originally enrolled as artillerymen; among them were those able and unable, and shadow registration was inconvenient—therefore they were now sorted.
translations.idiomatic: Because campaign households found the burden heavy, in Zhiyuan 4 (1267) subsidies were drawn from original artillery households; since ability varied and false registration caused trouble, they were now sorted out.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，以瓜州、沙州鷹房三百人充軍。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, three hundred falconers of Guazhou and Shazhou were made to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 8 three hundred falconers from Guazhou and Shazhou were conscripted.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，河南省請益兵，敕諸路簽軍三萬，詔元帥府、統軍司、總管萬戶府閱實軍籍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, the Henan Branch Secretariat requested additional troops; an edict ordered the various circuits to register thirty thousand soldiers, and commanded the marshal's office, Army Command, and chief myriarch's office to verify the military registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 9 Henan requested reinforcements; the throne ordered thirty thousand men conscripted circuit-wide and the marshal's office, Army Command, and myriarchs to verify the rolls.

sentences.zh: 二月，命阿術典行省蒙古軍，劉整、阿裏海牙典漢軍。

translations.literal: In the second month, Ashu was ordered to take charge of the Mongol army of the branch secretariat, and Liu Zheng and Alihaiya to take charge of the Han army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Ashu was placed over the branch secretariat's Mongol forces and Liu Zheng and Alihaiya over the Han army.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔：「諸路軍戶驅丁，除至元六年前從良入民籍者當差。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, an edict stated: 'Bond servants of military households in the various circuits—apart from those who before the sixth year of Zhiyuan obtained freedom and entered the civilian register—shall perform corvée.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict ordered: 'Bond servants of military households in all circuits, except those freed into the civilian register before Zhiyuan 6 (1269), shall perform corvée.'

sentences.zh: 七年後，凡從良文書寫從便為民者，亦如之。

translations.literal: After the seventh year, all who obtained freedom with documents written as they pleased to become civilians were likewise treated.
translations.idiomatic: After year 7, those freed with documents permitting civilian status were treated the same.

sentences.zh: 余雖從良，並令津助本戶軍役。

translations.literal: The remainder, though freed, were all ordered to assist the military service of their original households.
translations.idiomatic: All others, though freed, were still required to support their former household's military obligations.'

sentences.zh: 」七月，閱大都、京兆等處探馬赤戶名籍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the household registers of Tamma troops in the Dadu, Jingzhao, and other regions were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tamma household registers in Dadu, Jingzhao, and elsewhere were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔樞密：「諸路正軍貼戶及同籍親戚僮奴，丁年堪役，依諸王權要以避役者，並還之軍，惟匠藝精巧者以名聞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs was commanded: 'Principal and supplementary military households and kinsmen and bondservants on the same register, of age fit for service, who have relied on princely influence to evade service—all are to be returned to the army; only those with exquisite craft skills may be reported by name.'
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the bureau was ordered: 'Principal and supplementary soldiers, kin, and bondservants fit for service who have used princely influence to evade duty must return to the rolls; only master craftsmen may be reported by name.'

sentences.zh: 」十二月，命府州司縣達魯花赤及治民長官，不妨本職，兼管諸軍奧魯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, darughachi of prefectures, subprefectures, departments, and counties and civil administrators were ordered, without hindering their regular duties, also to oversee the oru of all troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month prefectural darughachi and civil chiefs were ordered to oversee military oru without neglecting their regular duties.

sentences.zh: 各路總管府達魯花赤、總管，別給宣命印信，府州司縣達魯花赤長官止給印信，任滿則別具解由，申樞密院。

translations.literal: The darughachi and chief administrators of each route's chief administrator's office were separately given commission patents and seals; darughachi and chiefs of prefectures, subprefectures, departments, and counties were given seals only; when their terms ended they separately prepared certificates of discharge and reported to the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Route darughachi and prefects received separate patents and seals; county darughachi received seals only; on completing their terms they filed discharge papers with the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，合剌請於渠江之北雲門山及嘉陵西岸虎頭山立二戍，以其圖來上，仍乞益兵二萬，敕給京兆新簽軍五千人益之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, Hela requested that two garrisons be established on Yunmen Mountain north of the Qu River and on Hutou Mountain on the west bank of the Jialing; he presented his map and still begged twenty thousand additional troops; an edict gave five thousand newly registered soldiers of Jingzhao to reinforce him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 10 Hela proposed garrisons on Yunmen Mountain north of the Qu River and Hutou Mountain on the Jialing's west bank, presented his map, and requested twenty thousand men; five thousand newly conscripted Jingzhao troops were assigned.

sentences.zh: 陜西京兆、延安、鳳翔三路諸色人戶，約六萬戶內，簽軍六千。

translations.literal: Among households of various categories in the three circuits of Shaanxi, Jingzhao, Yan'an, and Fengxiang—about sixty thousand households—six thousand soldiers were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand soldiers were conscripted from roughly sixty thousand households of all categories in Jingzhao, Yan'an, and Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 五月，禁乾討虜人，其願充軍者，於萬戶、千戶內結成牌甲，與大軍一體征進。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, freebooting plunderers were forbidden; those willing to serve as soldiers were to be formed into arban within myriarchies and chiliarchies and campaign together with the main army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month freebooting was banned; volunteers were organized into arban under myriarchs and chiliarchs and marched with the main army.

sentences.zh: 八月，禁軍吏之長舉債，不得重取其息，以損軍力，違者罪之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, it was forbidden for senior military clerks to lend money and take heavy interest, lest military strength be impaired; violators were punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month senior military clerks were forbidden to lend at usurious rates and weaken the army; violators were prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 九月，襄陽生券軍至都釋械系免死，聽自立部伍，俾征日本，仍於蒙古、漢人內選官率領之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Xiangyang life-coupon soldiers reached the capital, were disarmed and bound but spared death, permitted to form their own companies, ordered to campaign against Japan, and officers were still chosen from among Mongols and Han to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Xiangyang life-coupon troops reached the capital, were disarmed but spared, allowed to form their own units for the Japan campaign, with Mongol and Han officers chosen to lead them.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，初立軍官以功升散官格。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year, regulations were first established for military officers to be promoted to honorary ranks according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 11 regulations were first set for promoting officers to honorary ranks by merit.

sentences.zh: 五月，便宜總帥府言：「本路軍經今四十年間，或死或逃，無丁不能起補，見在軍少，乞選擇堪與不堪丁力，放罷貧乏無丁者，於民站內別選充役。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the expedient supreme commander's office stated: 'The troops of this circuit over the past forty years have died or fled; without adult males they cannot be replenished; the soldiers presently available are few. We beg to select those fit and unfit in strength, release the poor without adult males, and separately choose replacements from among civilian relay households.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the expedient command reported: 'Over forty years our troops have died or fled; without adult males we cannot refill the ranks. Release the poor and childless and select replacements from civilian relay households.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 詔延安府、沙井、凈州等處種田白達達戶，選其可充軍者，簽起出征。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that among the farming White Tatar households of Yan'an prefecture, Shajing, Jingzhou, and other places, those fit for military service were to be selected and registered for campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that farming White Tatar households in Yan'an, Shajing, Jingzhou, and elsewhere select men fit for service and send them on campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，潁州屯田總管李珣言：「近為簽軍事，乞依徐、邳州屯田例，每三丁內，一丁防城，二丁納糧，可簽丁壯七百餘人，並元撥保甲丁壯，令珣通領，鎮守潁州，代見屯納合監戰軍馬別用。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Li Xun, chief administrator of the Yingzhou garrison-colony, stated: 'Recently because of soldier registration, I beg to follow the precedent of the Xuzhou and Pizhou garrison-colonies: of every three adult males, one guards the city and two pay grain tax; more than seven hundred strong youths can be registered, together with the baojia strong youths originally assigned, placed under Xun's overall command to guard Yingzhou, replacing the present colony grain payments and supervising war horses for separate use.'
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Li Xun, Yingzhou colony chief, proposed following the Xuzhou and Pizhou precedent: one of every three adult males to guard the walls, two to pay grain tax; over seven hundred strong youths plus existing baojia men under his command to garrison Yingzhou and free colony grain for war-horse supervision.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，遣官往遼東，簽揀蒙古達魯花赤、千戶、百戶等官子弟出軍。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year, officials were dispatched to Liaodong to register and select the sons and younger brothers of Mongol darughachi, chiliarchs, centurions, and other officers for military service.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 12 officials were sent to Liaodong to conscript sons of Mongol darughachi, chiliarchs, and centurions.

sentences.zh: 詔隨處所置襄陽生券軍之為農者，或自願充軍，具數以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that among the Xiangyang life-coupon soldiers placed everywhere who were farming, those who voluntarily wished to serve as soldiers should report their numbers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiangyang life-coupon troops farming in the provinces who wished to serve as soldiers to report their numbers.

sentences.zh: 五月，正陽萬戶劉復亨言：「新下江南三十餘城，俱守以兵，及江北、淮南、潤、揚等處未降，軍力分散，調度不給，以致鎮巢軍、滁州兩處復叛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Liu Fuheng, myriarch of Zhengyang, stated: 'More than thirty newly taken cities south of the Yangtze are all held by troops, and places north of the river, Huainan, Runzhou, Yangzhou, and others have not yet submitted; military strength is scattered and supplies cannot be met, so that Zhenchao Army and Chuzhou rebelled again.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Liu Fuheng, Zhengyang myriarch, reported: 'Over thirty newly taken Jiangnan cities require garrisons, while north of the Yangtze, Huainan, Runzhou, and Yangzhou remain unsubdued; forces are overstretched and supplies fail, allowing Zhenchao and Chuzhou to rebel again.'

sentences.zh: 乞簽河西等戶為軍，並力剿除，庶無後患。

translations.literal: We beg to register households of Hexi and other regions as soldiers and join forces to exterminate them, so that there may be no later trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Register Hexi and other households as soldiers to crush the rebels together and forestall further trouble.'

sentences.zh: 」有旨，命肅州達魯花赤，並遣使同往驗各色戶計物力富強者簽起之。

translations.literal: There was an imperial order commanding the darughachi of Suzhou and dispatching envoys together to verify households of various categories and register the wealthy and strong.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the Suzhou darughachi and envoys to verify households of all categories and conscript the wealthy and strong.

sentences.zh: 六月，簽平陽、西京、延安等路達魯花赤弟男為軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the younger brothers and sons of darughachi of the Pingyang, Xijing, Yan'an, and other circuits were registered as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month sons and younger brothers of darughachi in Pingyang, Xijing, Yan'an, and other circuits were conscripted.

sentences.zh: 萊州酒稅官王貞等上言：「國家討平殘宋，吊伐為事，何嘗以賄利為心。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen and others, wine-tax officials of Laizhou, submitted: 'The state in subduing the remnant Song took comforting the oppressed and punishing the wrongdoer as its task—when did it ever take bribes and profit as its aim?'
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen and other Laizhou wine-tax officials submitted: 'In conquering the remnant Song the state acted to comfort the oppressed and punish wrongdoers—never to seek bribes and profit.'

sentences.zh: 彼不紹事業小人，貪圖貨利，作乾討虜名目，侵掠彼地，所得人口，悉皆貨賣，以充酒食之費，勝則無益朝廷，敗則實為辱國。

translations.literal: Those base men who do not continue the enterprise, greedy for goods and profit, under the name of freebooting plunderers invade those lands; the people they obtain are all sold off to pay for wine and food. If they win, the court gains nothing; if they lose, it truly shames the state.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men who abandon the enterprise, greedy for profit, raid under the name of freebooters, sell captives for wine and food, bring the court no benefit when they win, and shame the state when they lose.

sentences.zh: 其招討司所收乾討虜人，可悉罷之，第其高下，籍為正軍，命各萬戶管領征進，一則得其實用，二則正王師吊伐之名，實為便益。

translations.literal: The freebooting plunderers received by the pacification commission can all be dismissed; rank them high and low, register them as principal soldiers, and have each myriarch command them on campaign—first, to gain their real utility; second, to set right the name of the royal army as comforter and punisher; this is truly beneficial.
translations.idiomatic: Dismiss the freebooters collected by the pacification commission, rank them, register them as regular soldiers under myriarchs for campaign—both to use them effectively and to restore the royal army's name as comforter and punisher.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，詔：「上都、隆興、西京、北京四路編民捕獵等戶，簽選丁壯軍二千人，防守上都。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year, an edict stated: 'From registered civilians, hunters, and other households of the four circuits of Shangdu, Longxing, Xijing, and Beijing, select two thousand strong youths as soldiers to guard Shangdu.'
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 14 an edict ordered two thousand strong youths conscripted from registered civilians and hunters in Shangdu, Longxing, Xijing, and Beijing to guard the upper capital.'

sentences.zh: 」中書省議：「從各路搭配，二十五戶內取軍一名，選善騎射者充，官給行資中統鈔一錠，仍自備鞍馬衣裝器仗，編立牌甲，差官部領，前來赴役。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat deliberated: 'From each circuit in combination, one soldier from every twenty-five households; choose those skilled in riding and archery; the government gives travel funds of one ding of Zhongtong notes; they still provide their own saddles, horses, clothing, and weapons; establish arban; dispatch officials to lead them; come forward to perform service.'
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat proposed: 'Levy one soldier per twenty-five households circuit-wide, skilled in riding and archery, with one ding of Zhongtong notes for travel, their own mounts and gear, organized in arban under dispatched officers.'

sentences.zh: 」十二月，樞密院臣言：「收附亡宋州城，新附請糧官軍，並通事馬軍人等，軍官不肯存恤，多逃散者，乞招誘之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, ministers of the Bureau of Military Affairs stated: 'In the captured cities of the fallen Song, the newly attached grain-receiving troops and interpreter cavalry and others—because officers would not care for them, many have fled and scattered; we beg to recruit them back.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month bureau ministers reported: 'Newly attached Song grain troops and interpreter cavalry have fled because officers neglect them; we beg permission to recruit them back.'

sentences.zh: 」命左丞陳巖等，分揀堪當軍役者，收系充軍，依舊例月支錢糧。

translations.literal: Chen Yan, left vice minister, and others were ordered to sort those fit for military service, take them in and enroll them as soldiers, and pay monthly grain and money according to the old regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yan and others were ordered to select men fit for service, enroll them as soldiers, and pay monthly grain and money as before.

sentences.zh: 其生券不堪當軍者，官給牛具糧食，屯田種養。

translations.literal: Those with life coupons unfit for military service were given ox-teams and grain by the government for garrison-colony farming and raising livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Life-coupon men unfit for service received government ox-teams and grain for colony farming.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，定軍官承襲之制。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year, regulations for military officers' inheritance were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 15 regulations for inheriting military offices were fixed.

sentences.zh: 凡軍官之有功者升其秩，元受之職，令他有功者居之，不得令子侄復代。

translations.literal: For all military officers with merit, their rank was raised; the post originally held was given to another man of merit to occupy; sons and nephews might not succeed in their place.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious officers were promoted; their original posts went to other meritorious men; sons and nephews could not succeed automatically.

sentences.zh: 陣亡者始得承襲，病死者降一等。

translations.literal: Only those who died in battle might inherit; those who died of illness had the rank lowered one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Inheritance was allowed only for death in battle; death from illness reduced the rank by one grade.

sentences.zh: 總把、百戶老病死，不在承襲之例。

translations.literal: Chief captains and centurions who died of old age or illness were not within the cases for inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: Chief captains and centurions who died of old age or illness could not pass their posts to heirs.

sentences.zh: 凡將校臨陣中傷、還營病創者，亦令與陣亡之人一體承襲。

translations.literal: All officers and NCOs wounded in battle on the field, or who returned to camp and died of wounds, were likewise ordered to inherit on the same terms as those who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Officers wounded in battle or who died of wounds after returning to camp inherited on the same terms as those killed in action.

sentences.zh: 禁長軍之官不恤士卒，及士卒亡命避役，侵擾初附百姓者，俱有罪。

translations.literal: It was forbidden for officers in long command not to care for the soldiers, and for soldiers to flee and evade service or harass newly submitted common people—all were guilty.
translations.idiomatic: Officers in long command who neglected their men, soldiers who fled or evaded service, and those who harassed newly submitted civilians were all punishable.

sentences.zh: 雲南行省言：「雲南舊屯駐蒙古軍甚少，遂取漸長成丁怯困都等軍，以備出征。

translations.literal: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat stated: 'The Mongol troops formerly garrisoned in Yunnan are very few; therefore the Gradual Muster, Qiedundu, and other armies of youths grown to adulthood are taken to prepare for campaign.'
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat reported: 'Few Mongol troops are garrisoned in Yunnan; Gradual Muster and Qiedundu youths are therefore drafted for campaign.'

sentences.zh: 雲南闊遠，多未降之地，必須用兵，已簽爨、僰人一萬為軍，續取新降落落、和泥等人，亦令充軍。

translations.literal: Yunnan is broad and remote, with many places not yet submitted; troops must be used. Ten thousand Cuan and Bo people have already been registered as soldiers; newly submitted tribes and Heni people are also ordered to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan is vast and remote with many unsubdued regions; ten thousand Cuan and Bo have been conscripted, and newly submitted tribes and Heni are also enrolled.

sentences.zh: 然其人與中原不同，若赴別地出征，必致逃匿，宜令就各所居一方未降處用之。

translations.literal: Yet these people differ from the Central Plains; if sent to campaign in other regions, they will surely flee and hide; they should be ordered to serve in the unsubdued places of each region where they dwell.
translations.idiomatic: These peoples differ from Central Plains subjects; sent abroad they would flee; they should campaign only in unsubdued regions near their homes.'

sentences.zh: 」九月，並軍士。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, soldiers were consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month troop rolls were consolidated.

sentences.zh: 初，至元九年簽軍三萬，止擇精銳年壯者，不復問其貲產，且無貼戶之助，歲久多貧乏不堪。

translations.literal: At first, in the ninth year of Zhiyuan thirty thousand soldiers were registered, choosing only elite and young men, no longer inquiring into their property, and without supplementary households to assist; over the years many became poor and unable to bear it.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 9 thirty thousand soldiers were conscripted, choosing only elite young men without regard to wealth and without supplementary households; over time many grew destitute.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣奏，宜縱為民，遂並為一萬五千。

translations.literal: Ministers of the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized that they ought to be released as civilians; they were therefore consolidated to fifteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau ministers proposed releasing them to civilian status; the force was consolidated to fifteen thousand.

sentences.zh: 諸軍戶投充諸侯王怯憐口、人匠，或托為別戶以避其役者，復令為軍，有良匠則別而出之。

translations.literal: Military households who had entered the service of feudal princes as qielian retainers or artisans, or who had relied on other households to evade service, were again ordered to be soldiers; skilled artisans were separately released.
translations.idiomatic: Military households who had become princely retainers or artisans, or evaded service through other households, were restored to the rolls; skilled artisans were separately exempted.

sentences.zh: 樞密臣又言：「至元八年，於各路軍之為富商大賈者一百四十三戶，各增一軍，號余丁軍。

translations.literal: Ministers of the bureau again stated: 'In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, among troops of the various circuits who were great merchants, 143 households each added one soldier, called surplus-male troops.'
translations.idiomatic: Bureau ministers added: 'In Zhiyuan 8, 143 wealthy merchant military households each supplied an additional soldier as surplus-male troops.'

sentences.zh: 今東平等路諸奧魯總管府言，往往人死產乏，不能充二軍，乞免余丁充役者。

translations.literal: Now the oru chief administrator's offices of Dongping and other circuits state that often when people die and property is exhausted they cannot furnish two soldiers; they beg exemption for surplus-male service.
translations.idiomatic: Dongping and other oru offices report that deaths and property exhaustion often prevent furnishing two soldiers; they request exemption from surplus-male service.'

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，樞密院官議：「諸軍官在軍籍者，除百戶、總把權準軍役，其元帥、招討、萬戶、總管、千戶或首領官，俱合再當正軍一名。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated: 'Military officers on the military register—apart from centurions and chief captains, who are deemed equivalent to military service—marshals, pacification commissioners, myriarchs, chief administrators, chiliarchs, or leading officers should all likewise perform duty as one principal soldier.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month bureau officials ruled: 'Officers on the military register—except centurions and chief captains, who count as serving—marshals, pacification commissioners, myriarchs, prefects, chiliarchs, and leading officers must each perform duty as one principal soldier.'

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，罷五翼探馬赤重役軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year, the heavy-service troops of the five wings of Tamma cavalry were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 16 the heavy-service troops of the five Tamma wings were abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月，括兩淮造回回炮新附軍匠六百人，及蒙古、回回、漢人、新附人能造炮者，至京師。

translations.literal: In the third month, six hundred newly attached artisan soldiers of the two Huai regions who made Muslim cannon were gathered, together with Mongols, Muslims, Han, and newly attached persons able to make cannon, and brought to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month six hundred newly attached artisans from the two Huai who made Muslim cannon, plus Mongols, Muslims, Han, and other gunners, were brought to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月，淮西道宣慰司官昂吉兒請招諭亡宋通事軍，俾屬之麾下。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Angu'er, an official of the Huaixi Route Pacification Commission, requested to recruit and win over the interpreter troops of the fallen Song and place them under his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Angu'er of the Huaixi Pacification Commission asked to recruit the fallen Song's interpreter troops under his command.

sentences.zh: 初，亡宋多招納北地蒙古人為通事軍，遇之甚厚，每戰皆列於前行，願效死力。

translations.literal: At first, the fallen Song had recruited many Mongols of the northern lands as interpreter troops, treated them very generously, placed them in the front rank in every battle, and they were willing to exert their utmost strength unto death.
translations.idiomatic: The fallen Song had recruited many northern Mongols as interpreter troops, treated them generously, placed them in the front rank, and they fought willingly unto death.

sentences.zh: 及宋亡，無所歸。

translations.literal: When the Song perished, they had nowhere to return.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song fell, they had nowhere to go.

sentences.zh: 朝議欲編入版籍未暇也，人人疑懼，皆不自安。

translations.literal: The court deliberated on enrolling them in the registers but had no leisure; everyone was suspicious and fearful, none at ease.
translations.idiomatic: The court had intended to enroll them in the registers but had not yet done so; they were all fearful and uneasy.

sentences.zh: 至是，昂吉兒請招集，列之行伍，以備征戍。

translations.literal: At this time Angu'er requested to gather them, array them in ranks, and prepare them for campaign and garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Angu'er now asked to gather them into ranks for campaign and garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔河西地未簽軍之官，及富強戶有物力者，簽軍六百人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict ordered that officials of the Hexi region not yet registered as soldiers and wealthy households with property were to register six hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict ordered six hundred soldiers conscripted from Hexi officials not yet on the rolls and wealthy households.

sentences.zh: 十月，壽州等處招討使李鐵哥，請召募有罪亡命之人充軍，其言：「使功不如使過。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Li Tiego, pacification commissioner of Shouzhou and other places, requested to recruit guilty fugitives to serve as soldiers, saying: 'To employ merit is not as good as to employ fault.'
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Li Tiego, Shouzhou pacification commissioner, proposed recruiting guilty fugitives as soldiers, saying: 'It is better to employ the faulty than the meritorious.'

sentences.zh: 始南宋未平時，蒙古、諸色人等，因得罪皆亡命往依焉，今已平定，尚逃匿林藪。

translations.literal: At first, before the Southern Song was pacified, Mongols and persons of various categories, because of offenses, all fled as outlaws to take refuge with them; now it is pacified, yet they still hide in forests and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Southern Song fell, Mongols and others who had offended fled to join them; now that the realm is pacified, they still hide in the wilds.

sentences.zh: 若釋其罪而用之，必能效力，無不一當十者矣。

translations.literal: If their crimes are released and they are employed, they will surely be able to exert strength; none will fail to be worth ten men.
translations.idiomatic: If pardoned and employed, they will fight hard—each worth ten ordinary men.'

sentences.zh: 」十一月，罷太原、平陽、西京、延安路新簽軍還籍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the newly registered soldiers of the Taiyuan, Pingyang, Xijing, and Yan'an circuits were abolished and returned to the registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month newly conscripted troops in Taiyuan, Pingyang, Xijing, and Yan'an were discharged back to the rolls.

sentences.zh: 十七年七月，詔江淮諸路招集答剌罕軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventeenth year, an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai circuits to gather the Talqan Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 17 an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai circuits to gather the Talqan Army.

sentences.zh: 初平江南，募死士願從軍者，號答剌罕，屬之劉萬戶麾下。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan was first pacified, daredevils willing to join the army were recruited; they were called Talqan and placed under the myriarch Liu.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan was first pacified, volunteers willing to die for the cause were called Talqan and placed under Myriarch Liu.

sentences.zh: 南北既混一，復散之，其人皆無所歸，率群聚剽掠。

translations.literal: When north and south were united, they were again dispersed; these men all had nowhere to go and mostly gathered in bands to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: After north and south were united they were dispersed; with nowhere to go, they banded together to plunder.

sentences.zh: 至是，命諸路招集之，令萬奴部領如故，聽範左丞、李拔都二人節制。

translations.literal: At this time, the various circuits were ordered to gather them; Wannu was to command them as before, subject to the regulation of the two men Left Vice Minister Fan and Li Badu.
translations.idiomatic: The circuits were now ordered to gather them; Wannu was to command them as before under Fan, left vice minister, and Li Badu.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，並貧乏軍人三萬戶為一萬五千，取帖戶津帖正軍充役。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year, thirty thousand poor military households were consolidated to fifteen thousand; supplementary households were to subsidize principal soldiers for service.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 18 thirty thousand poor military households were consolidated to fifteen thousand, with supplementary households subsidizing principal soldiers.

sentences.zh: 四月，置蒙古、漢人、新附軍總管。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, chief administrators for Mongol, Han, and newly attached armies were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month chief administrators were established for Mongol, Han, and newly attached forces.

sentences.zh: 六月，樞密院議：「正軍貧乏無丁者，令富強丁多帖戶權充正軍應役，驗正軍物力，卻令津濟貼戶，其正軍仍為軍頭如故。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated: 'Principal soldiers who are poor and without adult males—order wealthy supplementary households with many adult males temporarily to perform service as principal soldiers; verify the property of the principal soldier and have him subsidize the supplementary household; the principal soldier still remains the company head as before.'
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the bureau ruled: 'Poor principal soldiers without adult males—wealthy supplementary households with many males shall temporarily serve in their place; the principal soldier, verified for property, shall subsidize the supplementary household and remain company head.'

sentences.zh: 或正軍實系單丁者，許傭雇練習之人應役，丁多者不得傭雇，軍官亦不得以親從人代之。」

translations.literal: Or if the principal soldier truly has only a single adult male, he may hire practiced men to perform service; those with many adult males may not hire; officers also may not substitute kinsmen and attendants.'
translations.idiomatic: Principal soldiers with only one adult male may hire trained substitutes; those with many males may not; officers may not substitute kin or attendants.'

sentences.zh: 十九年二月，諸侯王阿只吉遣使言：「探馬赤軍凡九處出征，各奧魯內復征雜泛徭役，不便。

translations.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year, the feudal prince Ajiji sent envoys stating: 'The Tamma Army is on campaign in nine places; within each oru miscellaneous corvée is again levied—this is inconvenient.'
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 19 Prince Ajiji reported: 'Tamma troops campaign in nine places while their oru still bear miscellaneous corvée—this is burdensome.'

sentences.zh: 」詔免之，並詔有司毋重役軍戶。

translations.literal: An edict exempted them and also commanded the authorities not to impose heavy service on military households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted exemption and forbade officials to overburden military households.

sentences.zh: 六月，禁長軍之官，毋得占役士卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, it was forbidden for officers in long command to occupy soldiers for private service.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month officers in long command were forbidden to use soldiers for private labor.

sentences.zh: 散定海答剌罕軍還各營，及歸戍城邑。

translations.literal: The Dinghai Talqan Army was dispersed back to their respective camps and returned to garrison cities.
translations.idiomatic: The Dinghai Talqan Army was dispersed to their camps and returned to garrison towns.

sentences.zh: 十月，簽發漸丁軍士。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Gradual Muster soldiers were registered and sent forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Gradual Muster troops were conscripted.

sentences.zh: 遵舊制，家止一丁者不作數，凡二丁至五丁、六丁之家，止存一人，餘皆充軍。

translations.literal: Following the old regulation, households with only one adult male were not counted; for households of two to five or six adult males, only one was kept, the rest all serving as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rule, single-male households were exempt; households with two to six adult males kept one at home and conscripted the rest.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月，命各處行樞密院造新附軍籍冊。
