translations.literal: In the second month of the twentieth year, traveling Bureaus of Military Affairs everywhere were ordered to compile registers of the newly attached army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 20 traveling military bureaus were ordered to compile newly attached troop registers.

sentences.zh: 六月，從丞相伯顏議，所括宋手號軍八萬三千六百人，立牌甲，設官以統之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, following the deliberation of Chancellor Bayan, the 83,600 Song hand-mark troops gathered were formed into arban and given officers to command them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, per Chancellor Bayan's proposal, 83,600 gathered Song hand-mark troops were organized in arban under appointed officers.

sentences.zh: 十月，定出征軍人亡命之罪，為首者斬，余令減死一等。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the crime of campaign soldiers fleeing as outlaws was fixed: ringleaders were beheaded, the rest had death reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month desertion on campaign was codified: ringleaders were beheaded, followers received one grade below death.

sentences.zh: 二十一年八月，江東道僉事馬奉訓言：「劉萬奴乾討虜軍，私相糾合，結為徒黨，張弓挾矢，或詐稱使臣，莫若散之各翼萬戶、千戶、百戶、牌甲內管領為便。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-first year, Ma Fengxun, commissioner of the Jiangdong circuit, stated: 'The freebooting troops of Myriarch Liu privately band together, form factions, draw bows and carry arrows, or falsely claim to be envoys—it would be better to disperse them among the wings, myriarchies, chiliarchies, centurions, and arban for command.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 21 Ma Fengxun, Jiangdong commissioner, reported: 'Myriarch Liu's freebooters band together armed and sometimes pose as envoys—they should be dispersed among wings, myriarchies, chiliarchies, centurions, and arban.'

sentences.zh: 」省院官以聞，有旨，可令問此軍：「欲從脫歡出征虜掠耶？

translations.literal: Secretariat and bureau officials reported this; there was an imperial order that these troops might be asked: 'Do you wish to follow Tohoa on campaign to plunder?'
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat and bureau officials reported this; the throne ordered the troops asked: 'Do you wish to follow Tohoa on campaign to plunder?'

sentences.zh: 欲且放散還家耶？

translations.literal: Or do you wish to be dispersed for now and return home?'
translations.idiomatic: Or do you wish to be dispersed and return home for now?'

sentences.zh: 」回奏：「眾軍皆言，自圍襄樊渡江以來，與國效力，願令還家少息。

translations.literal: They reported back: 'All the troops say that since the siege of Xiang-Fan and crossing the Yangtze they have served the state and beg to be sent home for a brief rest.'
translations.idiomatic: They reported back: 'All the men say that since the siege of Xiangyang-Fancheng and the Yangtze crossing they have served the state and beg to go home for rest.'

sentences.zh: 」遂從之。

translations.literal: Their request was then approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 籍亡宋手記軍。

translations.literal: The hand-mark troops of the fallen Song were registered.
translations.idiomatic: The fallen Song's hand-mark troops were registered.

sentences.zh: 宋時有是軍，死則以兄弟若子承代。

translations.literal: In Song times there was this army; when one died, a brother or son succeeded in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song this corps existed; on death a brother or son succeeded.

sentences.zh: 有旨，依漢軍例籍之，毋涅其手。

translations.literal: There was an imperial order to register them according to the Han army precedent, without tattooing their hands.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered them registered like Han troops, without hand tattooing.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，立行樞密院於江南三省，其各處行省見管軍馬悉以付焉。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-second year, traveling Bureaus of Military Affairs were established in the three provinces of Jiangnan; all troops presently under the various branch secretariats were entrusted to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 22 traveling military bureaus were established in the three Jiangnan provinces, receiving all troops under the branch secretariats.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔福建黃華畬軍，有恒產者放為民，無恒產與妻子者編為守城軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict ordered that among the Huanghua She troops of Fujian, those with fixed property were released as civilians; those without fixed property, with wives and children, were enrolled as wall-guard troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict ordered Fujian's Huanghua She troops with property released as civilians; those without property but with families enrolled as wall guards.

sentences.zh: 征交趾蒙古軍五百人、漢軍二千人，除留蒙古軍百人、漢軍四百人，為鎮南王脫歡宿衛，余悉遣還，別以江淮行樞密院蒙古軍戍江西。

translations.literal: For the campaign against Jiaozhi there were five hundred Mongol soldiers and two thousand Han soldiers; apart from retaining one hundred Mongol and four hundred Han as palace guard for the Prince of Zhennan Tohoa, the rest were all sent back; separately Mongol troops of the Jiang-Huai traveling Bureau of Military Affairs garrisoned Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: For the Jiaozhi campaign five hundred Mongol and two thousand Han troops were sent; one hundred Mongol and four hundred Han remained as Prince Tohoa's guard, the rest were sent home, and Jiang-Huai bureau Mongol troops garrisoned Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十月，從月的迷失言，以乾討虜軍七百人，籍名數，立牌甲，命將官之無軍者領之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, following Yuedishimi's statement, seven hundred freebooting troops were entered in the registers by name and number, arban were established, and officers without troops were ordered to command them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, per Yuedishimi's proposal, seven hundred freebooters were registered, organized in arban, and assigned to officers without commands.

sentences.zh: 十一月，御史臺臣言：「昔宋以無室家壯士為鹽軍，內附之初，有五千人，除征占城運糧死亡者，今存一千一百二十二人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, censors stated: 'Formerly the Song used unmarried strong youths as salt troops; at the beginning of submission there were five thousand; apart from those who died transporting grain in the campaign against Champa, there remain today 1,122 persons.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month censors reported: 'The Song once used unmarried strong youths as salt troops; five thousand submitted at first; apart from deaths transporting grain in the Champa campaign, 1,122 remain today.'

sentences.zh: 此徒皆性習凶暴，民患苦之，宜給以衣糧，使屯田自贍，庶絕其擾。

translations.literal: These men are all by nature accustomed to violence; the people suffer from them. They should be given clothing and grain and made to garrison-colony and support themselves, so that their harassment may cease.
translations.idiomatic: These men are habitually violent and the people suffer; they should receive clothing and grain and farm colonies to support themselves, ending their harassment.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，從樞密院請，嚴立軍籍條例，選壯士及有力之家充軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, following the request of the Bureau of Military Affairs, military register regulations were strictly established; strong youths and powerful households were chosen to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, per the bureau's request, military register regulations were tightened and strong youths and wealthy households were selected for service.

sentences.zh: 舊例，丁力強者充軍，弱者出錢，故有正軍、貼戶之籍。

translations.literal: By the old regulation, those strong in adult male labor served as soldiers and the weak paid money; therefore there were registers of principal soldiers and supplementary households.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rule, strong males served as soldiers and weaker households paid subsidies, hence principal and supplementary military registers.

sentences.zh: 行之既久，而強者弱，弱者強，籍亦如故。

translations.literal: After it had been practiced long, the strong became weak and the weak became strong, yet the registers remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Practiced long enough, the strong grew weak and the weak grew strong, yet the registers stayed unchanged.

sentences.zh: 其同戶異居者，私立年期，以相更代，故有老稚不免從軍，而強壯家居者，至是革焉。

translations.literal: Those of the same household living separately privately fixed terms of years to take turns replacing one another; therefore the old and young could not escape military service while the strong and robust stayed home—this was now reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Households living apart privately rotated service by fixed terms, so the old and young marched while the fit stayed home—this was now abolished.

sentences.zh: 江浙省募鹽徒為軍，得四千七百六十六人，選軍官麾下無士卒者，相參統之，以備各處鎮守。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat recruited salt convicts as soldiers and obtained 4,766 men; officers without troops under their command were chosen to share in commanding them for garrison duty in various places.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe recruited 4,766 salt convicts as soldiers and assigned officers without commands to lead them for local garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 二十四年閏二月，樞密院臣言：「諸軍貼戶，有正軍已死者，有充工匠者，放為民者，有元系各投下戶回付者，似此歇閑一千三百四十戶，乞差人分揀貧富，定貼戶、正軍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month of the twenty-fourth year, ministers of the Bureau of Military Affairs stated: 'Among supplementary military households, some principal soldiers have died, some serve as artisans, some were released as civilians, some were originally appanage households returned—such idle households number 1,340; we beg to dispatch men to sort rich and poor and fix supplementary households and principal soldiers.'
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of year 24 bureau ministers reported: 'Among 1,340 idle supplementary households—some with dead principals, some artisans, some civilians, some returned appanage households—we beg officials to sort by wealth and fix principal and supplementary status.'

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十六年八月，樞密院議：「諸管軍官萬戶、千戶、百戶等，或治軍有法、鎮守無虞、鎧仗精完、差役均平、軍無逃竄者，許所司薦舉以聞，不次擢用。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-sixth year, the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated: 'Myriarchs, chiliarchs, centurions, and other officers in charge of troops who govern the army by law, garrison without alarm, have armor and weapons complete, distribute corvée evenly, and have no fleeing soldiers—let their superiors recommend and report them for extraordinary promotion.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 26 the bureau ruled: 'Officers who govern troops well, garrison securely, maintain complete arms, distribute duties fairly, and prevent desertion may be recommended for exceptional promotion.'

sentences.zh: 諸軍吏之長，非有上司之命，毋擅離職。

translations.literal: Senior military clerks, without orders from superiors, must not leave their posts on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Senior military clerks may not leave their posts without superior orders.

sentences.zh: 諸長軍者，及蒙古、漢軍，毋得妄言邊事。」

translations.literal: Officers in long command, and Mongol and Han troops, must not speak rashly of frontier affairs.'
translations.idiomatic: Officers in long command and Mongol and Han troops must not speak rashly of frontier affairs.'

sentences.zh: 成宗大德二年十二月，定各省提調軍馬官員。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Dade under Chengzong, officials in each province who directed troops and horses were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Dade 2 (1298) officials authorized to command troops in each province were defined.

sentences.zh: 凡用隨從軍士，蒙古長官三十名，次官二十名，漢人一十名；

translations.literal: For all use of attendant soldiers: Mongol senior officers thirty men, junior officers twenty men, Han ten men;
translations.idiomatic: Attendant soldiers were limited to thirty for Mongol senior officers, twenty for junior officers, and ten for Han officers;

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶、百戶人等，俱不得占役。

translations.literal: myriarchs, chiliarchs, centurions, and others—all may not occupy soldiers for private service.
translations.idiomatic: Myriarchs, chiliarchs, and centurions alike might not use soldiers for private labor.

sentences.zh: 行省鎮撫止用聽探外，亦不得多余役占。

translations.literal: Branch secretariat pacification commissioners might use only scouts and listeners, and likewise might not occupy extra labor.
translations.idiomatic: Branch secretariat pacifiers might employ only scouts and might not take extra labor beyond that.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，詔禮店軍還屬土番宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, an edict ordered that the Lidian troops be returned to belong to the Tubo Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 11 an edict returned the Lidian troops to the Tubo Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 初，西川也速叠兒、按住奴、帖木兒等所統探馬赤軍，自壬子年屬籍禮店，隸王相府，後王相府罷，屬之陜西省，桑哥奏屬土番宣慰司，咸以為不便，大德十年命依壬子之籍，至是復改屬焉。

translations.literal: At first, the Tamma troops commanded by Yesudie'er, Anzhunu, Temür, and others of western Sichuan, from the renzi year were registered under Lidian and subordinate to the prince's secretariat; later when the prince's secretariat was abolished they belonged to Shaanxi Province; Sangge memorialized that they belong to the Tubo Pacification Commission—all thought this inconvenient; in the tenth year of Dade it was ordered to follow the renzi registers; at this time they were again changed to belong there.
translations.idiomatic: Western Sichuan Tamma under Yesudie'er, Anzhunu, and Temür had been registered at Lidian since renzi (1252), first under the prince's secretariat, then Shaanxi; Sangge placed them under the Tubo commission, which was deemed inconvenient; Dade 10 restored the renzi arrangement; now they were reassigned again.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大元年正月，以通惠河千戶劉粲所領運糧軍九百二十人，屬萬戶赤因帖木爾兵籍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Zhida under Wuzong, the 920 grain-transport soldiers led by Liu Can, chiliarch of the Tonghui River, were placed under the military register of the myriarch Chiyintemür.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Zhida 1 (1308) the 920 grain-transport troops under Tonghui River Chiliarch Liu Can were transferred to Myriarch Chiyintemür's register.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丞相三寶奴等言：「國制，行省佐貳及宣慰使不得提調軍馬，若遙授平章、揚州宣慰使阿憐帖木兒者，嘗與成宗同乳母，故得行之，非常憲也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Chancellor Sanbaonu and others stated: 'By state regulation, vice ministers of branch secretariats and pacification commissioners may not direct troops and horses. Alintemür, remotely appointed acting chancellor and Yangzhou pacification commissioner, once shared a wet nurse with Chengzong and therefore was allowed to do so—this is not the regular statute.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Chancellor Sanbaonu reported: 'By statute branch vice ministers and pacification commissioners may not command troops. Alintemür, remotely appointed acting chancellor and Yangzhou pacifier, shared Chengzong's wet nurse and was exceptionally allowed to command—this is not regular law.'

sentences.zh: 今命沙的代之，宜遵國制，勿令提調。

translations.literal: Now Shadi is ordered to replace him; he should follow state regulation and not be allowed to direct troops.
translations.idiomatic: Shadi is now appointed in his place and should follow statute without commanding troops.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 仁宗皇慶元年三月，中書省臣奏李馬哥等四百戶為民。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Huangqing under Renzong, Central Secretariat ministers memorialized that the four hundred households of Li Mage and others should be civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Huangqing 1 (1312) Central Secretariat ministers proposed releasing the four hundred households of Li Mage and others to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 初，李馬哥等四百戶屬諸侯王脫脫，乙未年定籍為民，高麗林衍及乃顏叛，皆嘗簽為軍。

translations.literal: At first, the four hundred households of Li Mage and others belonged to the feudal prince Toto; in the yiwei year they were fixed in the register as civilians; when Lin Yan of Goryeo and Nayan rebelled, they were all once registered as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mage's four hundred households originally belonged to Prince Toto; in yiwei (1235) they were registered as civilians; during the rebellions of Korea's Lin Yan and Nayan they were conscripted.

sentences.zh: 至元八年置軍籍，以李馬哥等非七十二萬戶內軍數，復改為民。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan military registers were established; because Li Mage and others were not within the troop count of the 720,000 households, they were again changed to civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 8 military registers were established; because Li Mage's households were outside the 720,000-household quota they were restored to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，樞密院復奏為軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida, the Bureau of Military Affairs again memorialized to make them soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 (1311) the bureau again proposed conscripting them.

sentences.zh: 至是，省官以為言，命遵乙未年已定之籍。

translations.literal: At this time, secretariat officials spoke on the matter; it was ordered to follow the register fixed in the yiwei year.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat officials spoke up; the throne ordered the yiwei register followed.

sentences.zh: 後樞密復奏，竟以為軍戶。

translations.literal: Later the bureau again memorialized, and in the end they were made military households.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau memorialized again and they were ultimately enrolled as military households.

sentences.zh: 十二月，省臣言：「先是樞密院奏準，雲南省宜遵各省制，其省官居長者二員，得佩虎符，提調軍馬，余佐貳者不得預，已受虎符者悉收之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, secretariat ministers stated: 'Earlier the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized and was approved that Yunnan Province should follow the regulations of other provinces: its two senior provincial officials might wear tiger tallies and direct troops and horses, while other vice ministers might not participate; those who had already received tiger tallies were all to have them collected.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month ministers reported: 'The bureau had approved that Yunnan follow other provinces: two senior officials might wear tiger tallies and command troops, while vice ministers might not; existing tallies were to be collected.'

sentences.zh: 今雲南省言，本省籍軍士之力，以辦集錢谷，遇有調遣，則省官親率眾上馬，故舊制雖牧民官亦得佩虎符，領軍務，視他省為不同。

translations.literal: Now Yunnan Province states: 'This province relies on the strength of registered soldiers to collect money and grain; when there is deployment, provincial officials personally lead the multitude to mount horses; therefore by the old regulation even civil administrators may wear tiger tallies and lead military affairs—this differs from other provinces.'
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan now argued: 'We rely on registered soldiers to collect revenue; on deployment provincial officials lead troops in person; hence even civil administrators traditionally wore tiger tallies and commanded troops—unlike other provinces.'

sentences.zh: 臣等議，已受虎符者依故事，未受者宜頒賜之。

translations.literal: We ministers deliberated: those who have already received tiger tallies should follow precedent; those who have not should be granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers proposed: those already holding tallies should keep them by precedent; others should receive new ones.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，詔：「雲南省鎮遠方，掌邊務，凡事涉軍旅者，自平章至僚佐須同署押，其長官二員，復與哈必赤。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, an edict stated: 'Yunnan Province guards a distant region and manages frontier affairs; for all matters touching the army, from acting chancellor to aides all must jointly sign and seal; the two senior officials again receive habichi.'
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 2 an edict ordered: 'Yunnan guards a distant frontier; all military matters from acting chancellor to aides require joint signature; the two senior officials again receive habichi seals.'

sentences.zh: 延祐元年二月，四川省軍官闕員，詔：「依民官遷調之制，差人與本省提調官及監察御史同銓註。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yanyou, Sichuan Province had vacancies among military officers; an edict stated: 'Follow the regulation for transfer of civil officials; dispatch men to conduct selection together with this province's troop-directing officials and investigating censors.'
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yanyou 1 (1314) Sichuan had military officer vacancies; an edict ordered selection following civil transfer rules, with envoys, provincial troop directors, and censors jointly conducting appointments.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，命伯顏都萬戶府及紅胖襖總帥府各調軍九千五百人，往諸侯王所，更代守邊士卒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, the Chief Myriarch's Office of Bayan and the Supreme Commander's Office of the Red Padded Coat were each ordered to transfer nine thousand five hundred soldiers to the feudal princes' domains to relieve frontier garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 3 Bayan's chief myriarch's office and the Red Padded Coat supreme command each transferred 9,500 soldiers to princely domains to relieve frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 其屬都萬戶府者，軍一名，馬三匹；

translations.literal: those belonging to the chief myriarch's office: one soldier, three horses;
translations.idiomatic: Troops under the chief myriarch's office: one soldier with three horses;

sentences.zh: 屬總帥府者，軍一名，馬二匹。

translations.literal: those belonging to the supreme commander's office: one soldier, two horses.
translations.idiomatic: Troops under the supreme command: one soldier with two horses.

sentences.zh: 令人自為計，其貧不能自備者，則命行伍之長及百戶、千戶等助之。

translations.literal: Men were to plan for themselves; those too poor to equip themselves were ordered to be aided by company leaders and centurions and chiliarchs.
translations.idiomatic: Men were to provide for themselves; the poor were to be aided by company leaders, centurions, and chiliarchs.

sentences.zh: 悉遣精銳練習騎射之士。

translations.literal: Elite men practiced in riding and archery were all sent.
translations.idiomatic: Only elite troops trained in riding and archery were sent.

sentences.zh: 每軍一百名，百戶一員；

translations.literal: for every hundred soldiers, one centurion;
translations.idiomatic: Every hundred soldiers had one centurion;

sentences.zh: 五百名，千戶一員。

translations.literal: for five hundred, one chiliarch.
translations.idiomatic: Every five hundred had one chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 復命買住、囊加<角┦>二人分左右部領之。

translations.literal: Maiju and Nangajiao were again ordered to command them in left and right divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Maiju and Nangajiao were appointed to command the left and right divisions.
